svg.text: PyTorch, SBERT, LIME, Spotify API, OpenAI API

text.tspan: that connects 309 handwritten journal entries with
32K+ Spotify listening records to predict which song
will transport me back to a specific moment in time.
Fine-tuned SBERT and a custom VAE on triplet loss
to learn "mood embeddings" that map what I was
writing about to what I was obsessively replaying —
separation. Uses LIME for interpretability to validate
that the models latch onto meaningful words like
